verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents an MD_INFORMATION_SCHEMA.QUERY_HISTORY view that records every query across the organization, plus SQL usage views and a billing dashboard meant to help identify costly workloads and ways to reduce costs. That lets an engineer find which queries are expensive, but nothing in the evidence shows query profiles or execution plans that explain why a query is slow. missing for 10: EXPLAIN/EXPLAIN ANALYZE or execution-plan inspection, per-operator query profiling, UI profile visualization, any documentation of query-level timing/cost breakdowns, hands-on corroboration.
